'''Hiroki Touchi''' (Japanese: '''東地宏樹''' ''Tōchi Hiroki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Touchi was born on May 26, 1966, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and led a prolific career since the 1980s. Touchi provided his voice for [[Team Plasma]] scientist [[Colress]] during {{aniseries|BW}}. He also voiced [[Team Flare]] leader [[Lysandre]] in [[Pokémon Generations]] and [[Kabu]] in {{aniseries|HZ}}. He is currently affiliated with Office Osawa.
